notes.title: v1.0.01
notes.content:
- Fixed a bunch of fatal bugs caused by elevators
- Can now select bits from Bits window list directly
- WASD Support
- Space key can now pause / resume time
- Fixed bugged bathroom sprite
- Quick Dock Shortcut: Press CTRL + D to dock the game to the bottom right corner of your screen while you go about doing other things. Press CTRL + D again to exit docked mode. Does not work when game is in fullscreen mode.
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: A Small Update about the Next Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Just wanted to thank you for your interest in Bits at Work. And a huge thank you to everyone who left a review, reported bugs or suggested a feature in the discussions.

There is a lot I'd like add / fix in the game but for the time being, I need to focus my efforts on the other game I'm working on, Bit ESC. 

I've got a bunch of stuff planned for Bits at Work but just wanted to post this update to let anyone interested know that the next update might take a while.
